accepted_colon_examples: Markdown headings and labels followed by colons

answer_text_requirements.requirement: answer_text is a string after strict outer-schema parsing
answer_text is non-empty after Unicode whitespace trimming
answer_text contains at least one Unicode alphabetic character and is not punctuation, braces, brackets, quotes, or whitespace only
answer_text does not itself parse as a JSON object or array
answer_text does not itself parse as a Python dict or list
answer_text is not a single fenced code, JSON, YAML, or XML block and is not an XML document
answer_text does not start with a raw left-brace or left-bracket container
answer_text does not contain a strongly diagnostic internal snake_case field in a structurally key-like line-start position
the generic English word evidence followed by a colon is not sufficient by itself to establish a raw internal structure
answer_text can be displayed directly to a student as ordinary prose or Markdown

character_count_definition: Python Unicode code-point count of answer_text before trimming
strong_internal_key_position: Beginning of a line after optional horizontal whitespace, optional Markdown list marker, and optional quote characters; followed by a colon
minimum_length_policy: No minimum response length is imposed beyond excluding punctuation-only, structurally empty, or otherwise non-student-facing responses.
purpose: Blind deterministic mechanical pre-Judge format validation only
v1_compatibility: Narrows only the serialized-key false-positive rule; all container and genuine raw-internal-structure rejection rules remain in force.
word_count_definition: Count of Unicode word tokens matched by the deterministic regular expression \b\w+\b before trimming
